critique: The large foreground bokeh artifacts from prior iterations are gone, and both frames now read as a clean, pale-blue particle sheet spanning a black field. The motion remains gently organic, with the wave profile changing between t1 and t4. However, the result is now too dim and granular compared with an ethereal magical-plane thumbnail: it reads as discrete tiny dots rather than a softly luminous, cohesive plane. The deformation also still throws a broad tail of particles noticeably below the central horizon, weakening the refined thin-sheet silhouette.

suggestions.why: Slightly larger particles will consolidate the pinpoints into a more luminous continuous plane and give the existing glow something substantial to bloom.
Increase the soft magical radiance around the denser particle band without reintroducing oversized foreground bokeh.
Reduce field displacement so the animated wave remains present but the lower scattered tail pulls back toward a controlled planar horizon.
